query: Which human-factors endpoints will be primary (decision-change rate, inter-reader agreement, time-on-task, cognitive load, comprehension) and which instruments/tests will measure them?

response.query: Which human-factors endpoints will be primary (decision-change rate, inter-reader agreement, time-on-task, cognitive load, comprehension) and which instruments/tests will measure them?
response.answer: Decision-change rate, inter-reader agreement, time-on-task, cognitive load, and comprehension are primary human-factors endpoints; they are measured using tools like surveys, inter-rater reliability tests, and cognitive load scales.
